title: Canonical finite coefficient site comparison on total tensor complexes
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension and $X$ a scheme. At every positive level $A_{E,n}$ of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], use the etale complex and localization data of [def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow], the intrinsic pro-etale operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the exact ordinary and derived inverse images $
u_n^*$ of [def-sf-finite-coefficient-site-scalar-arrow]. Define the comparison $
u_n^*\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(
u_n^*P\otimes
u_n^*Q)$ for every pair of cochain complexes as the unique chain isomorphism sending each signed-total summand pure tensor of local etale sections to the corresponding intrinsic pure tensor of their images under the comparison and module-sheafification units. The localization comparison is the canonical exact-descent isomorphism $Q_{et}
u_n^*\cong
u_n^*Q_{proet}$.

source.place: last paragraph: transport the specified internal-Hom comparison to the pro-etale site; Stacks 00YV, 06YN, 07A4, 08J9

proof.text: The coefficient quotient is finite. Specialize the normalized total tensor comparison for finite rings to this quotient. Its summand normalization is equivalent to the original local-section normalization: the recorded etale total representative is the inclusion of the sheaf pure tensor, comparison units are natural, and the ordinary tensor comparison has the specified pure-section formula. The reverse implication is equality of summand maps by the two adjunctions and sheaf-tensor extensionality. The canonical map remains the uniquely normalized one.
